item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-27286d8dc2339f5b","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The Electoral Tribunal’s 2018 final opinion declared the presidential election valid and López Obrador president-elect after the electoral authority reported 156,792 of 156,807 polling stations installed, 63.43% participation, party representatives present at 99.89% of polling stations, and 286 electoral challenges rejected; López Obrador received 30,110,327 votes (53.20%).","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4","4B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Historical context only; concerns the 2018 election and does not directly establish conduct or outcomes in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The Tribunal formally validated the election and declared López Obrador president-elect; the operational election administration was conducted by INE and reviewed by the Tribunal.","limitations":["This source does not assess López Obrador’s conduct after taking office or his 2023 performance.","The document is an institutional legal determination, not an independent evaluation of campaign conduct beyond the matters adjudicated."]},{"source_id":"SRC-27286d8dc2339f5b","start_unit":19,"end_unit":21,"fact_summary":"The electoral framework provided free political debate and media-equity safeguards; authorities processed 98 requests for precautionary measures, granted 31, resolved 201 special sanctioning proceedings, and the Tribunal issued 463 review decisions. The Tribunal stated that critical and severe public-interest expression received broad protection, subject to limits for knowingly false criminal allegations.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Historical institutional context from the 2017–2018 election; not evidence of 2023 presidential conduct.","ruler_attribution":"These were actions and legal standards of INE and the Electoral Tribunal, not decisions attributed directly to López Obrador.","limitations":["The source does not show whether López Obrador personally supported, opposed, or complied with each safeguard.","It does not establish the condition of media freedom or political speech in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-27286d8dc2339f5b","start_unit":24,"end_unit":27,"fact_summary":"Campaign-finance rules imposed a presidential spending ceiling of 429,633,325 pesos; the electoral authority reported that none of the four presidential candidates exceeded the ceiling, although some parties were sanctioned for late or omitted reporting. Electoral acts were publicly published, party representatives attended 99.89% of polling stations, observers attended 17,300 stations, and 907 foreign visitors participated.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4","4B.6","5B.5","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Historical context from the 2018 election, not a direct 2023 fact.","ruler_attribution":"The controls and findings were attributed to INE and the Electoral Tribunal; the record does not attribute the reporting violations or compliance decisions personally to López Obrador.","limitations":["The source reports institutional findings rather than López Obrador’s personal financing, disclosure, or accountability behavior.","It does not address later campaign or public-finance practices during his presidency."]},{"source_id":"SRC-27286d8dc2339f5b","start_unit":29,"end_unit":33,"fact_summary":"The Electoral Tribunal reviewed and sometimes revoked INE rules that exceeded statutory authority, protected editorial and news-content freedom from state control, upheld an exception allowing independent candidates in marginalized municipalities to collect signatures on paper, and extended a filing deadline after earthquake-related suspension of electoral activities.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","4B.7","4B.9","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Historical institutional context from 2017–2018; it does not directly measure López Obrador’s 2023 conduct.","ruler_attribution":"The decisions were made by the Electoral Tribunal and INE; no direct attribution to López Obrador is established.","limitations":["The source demonstrates institutional review and correction, not presidential support for those rulings.","It does not establish whether these safeguards remained effective in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-27286d8dc2339f5b","start_unit":47,"end_unit":54,"fact_summary":"The Tribunal found that 205 district tally records had no inconsistencies and that remaining discrepancies in the 300 records were analyzed and mathematically corrected using internal act data and INE information before the final count.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.6","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Historical evidence from the 2018 election; not a 2023 performance fact.","ruler_attribution":"The correction process was conducted by the Electoral Tribunal using INE records; it is not attributed to López Obrador personally.","limitations":["The source documents administrative recording errors and their correction, but does not show intentional manipulation or presidential involvement.","It does not bear directly on López Obrador’s later institutional conduct."]},{"source_id":"SRC-27286d8dc2339f5b","start_unit":68,"end_unit":71,"fact_summary":"The Tribunal described the 2018 election as governed by certainty, legality, independence, impartiality, maximum publicity, objectivity, equal political rights, freedom of expression, information access, and effective judicial protection, and concluded that the election was free, authentic, periodic, universal, secret, and direct.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","4B.7","4B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The finding concerns the 2018 election and supplies only baseline institutional context for a 2023 assessment.","ruler_attribution":"The conclusion is the Tribunal’s institutional judgment, not a direct finding that López Obrador personally caused or upheld each condition.","limitations":["The generalized legal conclusion does not resolve allegations concerning executive conduct after 2018.","No 2023 outcome or institutional change is reported."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The sole supplied document concerns the 2017–2018 presidential election and López Obrador’s eligibility; it contains no direct evidence about his actions, policies, outcomes, or institutional conduct in 2023.","The facts therefore provide historical baseline and institutional-context evidence only, without scoring or extrapolating beyond the source."]}
